title: White Linen Square Neck Button-Front Midi Sundress with Wide Straps
description:
A clean, timeless linen sundress with a flattering square neckline, wide shoulder straps and a long row of buttons from neck to hem. The fitted bodice and waistband shape the waist, and the A-line skirt falls to an easy midi length. Made for beach holidays, city summers, brunch and sunset dinners.

✦ The Details
• Pure linen midi sundress with a cotton lining
• Square neckline with wide shoulder straps
• Full front button placket with decorative buttons
• Fitted bodice with a defined waistband
• A-line midi skirt

✦ Fabric & Craft
Made from pure linen with a soft cotton lining, so it stays breathable and is never see-through. Linen gets softer with every wash and creases naturally – that relaxed texture is part of its charm. Stitched in our own Jaipur unit.

✦ Fit & Size
Fitted through the bodice with a flowing A-line skirt. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Cat-eye sunglasses, pearl drops and a woven box bag for a city day. Flat sandals and a straw tote for the beach. Throw on a white shirt or a light blazer for the office.

✦ Shade Card – Choose Your Colour
Shown in white. Pick White, Ivory, Beige, Sage Green, Sky Blue, Blush Pink or Black from the shade card and we will stitch this exact dress in your colour – same price. Colours other than white are made to order and dispatch in 5–7 working days.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.

care: Gentle hand wash or machine wash cold on a delicate cycle. Dry in shade. Iron while slightly damp on medium heat.
